name: mfs-find
description: >- Search, grep, browse, and read across registered MFS data sources via the `mfs` CLI — codebases, docs, PDFs, web crawls, databases (postgres/mysql/mongo/snowflake/bigquery), issue trackers (jira/linear/github), CRMs (hubspot), chat (slack/discord/gmail/feishu), object stores (s3/gdrive). Use whenever the user asks to find, locate, look up, look across, or read something out of an already-configured MFS index. Trigger phrases include "search the codebase for", "find anywhere about", "where is
author: zilliztech
summary_zh: 通过命令行统一搜索和读取已配置的代码库、文档、数据库及聊天记录，适合跨数据源快速定位信息。
